//: built, nothing is bundled, and no dependency enters the repo — the
compiler is a machine tool like python3, installed globally.
The types themselves are JSDoc in ordinary .js files (src/shared/types.js
is the model). Typing the session, the field and the projection is what
would have caught the live/grid/paused confusion the rebuild exists to
remove, so invariant 7 is: this exits clean, always.
vendor/ is excluded because preact and htm are shipped minified and
untyped; src/html.js is the one file that touches them, and it says so.
Test files are excluded because they import node:test, and @types/node
would be a dependency — node --test is their check.
